dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: That's right, and for some reason it was an especially strange one. In the dream, I was constantly fighting with these weird fellows. No different from work, really...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: There was a strange researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute in my dream who claimed that they had discovered the secret treasure of the Liliacruces Ordo, and planned to transform us all into clockwork meka...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: And not the normal kind, I'm talking about machines made of stone... I mean, it was a dream, right? Stone people don't really exist.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I've been losing sleep in the fight against those guys... I bet Captain Chevreuse would've had trouble with that, let alone me...
